common_name: Mr and Mrs Bubbs Daylily (2026 Stout Silver Medal Winner)

planting.note: Set bare-root divisions in spring so the crown sits about an inch below soil level, in fertile, well-drained ground; established plants tolerate light afternoon shade but flower best in full sun.

directions: Grow in moderately fertile, well-drained soil in full sun, watering regularly through bud set and bloom but allowing the soil to dry slightly between waterings once established. Hybridized by Heidi Douglas, Mr and Mrs Bubbs was named the American Hemerocallis Society's Stout Silver Medal winner for 2026, the society's highest annual honor for a daylily cultivar. Deadhead spent blooms to tidy scapes and divide crowded clumps every three to four years in early spring to maintain strong flowering.
sources: AHS Stout Silver Medal winners list
